workspaceGate.failedBody: Your workspace didn't come through. Check your connection and try again.
workspaceGate.emptyBody: Houston could not find a workspace for your account. Try again or restart the app.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: How teammates see you across Houston.

photo.label: Picture
photo.hint: Square images look best. Houston shrinks it for you.

name.label: Display name
name.hint: Shown on your messages, your mentions and your team roster.

errors.notImage: Pick an image file, such as JPG, PNG, or WebP.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read that image. Try another one.
errors.tooLarge: That picture is too heavy to save. Try a smaller one.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.palettesDescription: Pick a palette for light and one for dark. What you see behind this window is the live result.
appearance.showsInLight: Shows when the app is in light mode
appearance.showsInDark: Shows when the app is in dark mode

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Get pinged when a task finishes or needs you
notifications.toggleFailed: Could not save your notification preference.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently delete this workspace and all its AI Employees.
dangerZone.confirmDescription: This will permanently delete this workspace and all its AI Employees. This cannot be undone.

has_members.title: Remove the other members first
has_members.body: People are still in this workspace. Remove them from People, or ask them to leave, then delete it.

subscription_active.title: Cancel the subscription first
subscription_active.body: This workspace still has an active subscription. Cancel it from Billing, then delete the workspace.

personal_space.title: Your personal workspace can't be deleted
personal_space.body: It goes away with your account. You can delete team workspaces you own.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account, your AI Employees, and everything stored in Houston.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your account, your AI Employees, and all your data stored in Houston, and signs you out on every device. There is no way to get any of it back. Files saved on your computer stay where they are.

errors.teamMember: You are still part of a team. Leave your teams, or hand them to someone else, then try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach Houston. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong and your account was not deleted. Please try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Run Houston without touching the mouse.

reportBug.title: Report bug
reportBug.intro: Tell us what went wrong. We'll send your message along with the logs from your last activity so we can see what happened. An idea, or something that just feels off, is welcome here too.
reportBug.timingTip: We only get the most recent activity, so send the report as soon as the bug happens for the most useful info.
reportBug.toastEquivalence: This is the same as tapping Report bug on the red error notification, you don't need to send both.
reportBug.label: What happened?
reportBug.placeholder: Describe the bug. What were you doing, what did you expect, what happened instead?

toasts.successBody: Mission control is on it, deploying a fix.
toasts.successBodyWithId: Mission control is on it, deploying a fix. Reference: {{id}}

migration.title: Cloud migration
migration.description: If your move to the cloud didn't finish, you can run it again.

rows.aboutMe: What your AI Employees know about you before they start
rows.apiKeys: Let other apps and AI assistants start tasks with your AI Employees
rows.reportBug: Something broke, or you have an idea? Tell us
rows.migration: Pick up your move to the cloud

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: Other apps, AI assistants, and automation tools can start tasks with your AI Employees. Each connection needs a key you create here. <docs>Read the developer docs</docs>.

empty.title: No API keys yet
empty.description: A key lets an app you trust start tasks with your AI Employees. Create one to connect your first app.

error.title: Couldn't load your keys
error.description: Something went wrong reaching the server. Check your connection and try again.

create.title: Create API key
create.subtitle: Give this key a name so you can recognize it later.
create.limitReached: You've reached the maximum of 20 keys. Revoke one you no longer use to create a new key.
create.revealSubtitle: "{{name}}" is ready. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.
create.warning: This is the only time you'll see this key. You won't be able to view it again after closing.

revoke.title: Revoke this key?
revoke.description: "{{name}}" will stop working right away. Any tool using it will lose access. This cannot be undone.

channels.title: Channels
channels.navDescription: Talk to your assistant from Slack
channels.intro: Your personal assistant, wherever you talk. Continue the same conversation in Houston and Slack.
channels.empty: Connect Slack to message your assistant directly.
channels.finishInSlack: Finish connecting in Slack, then return here.
channels.blocked: Your browser did not open Slack. Open it to finish connecting.
channels.completeInvalid: That Slack connection link is invalid or expired. Connect again.
channels.completeAlready: That Slack account is already connected to another Houston account. Disconnect it there first, then connect again.
channels.linkInstructions: Open your direct message with Houston in Slack and send this command.
channels.linkExpired: This code has expired. Get a new code to connect.
channels.disconnectDescription: {{name}} will stop receiving assistant replies in Slack. Your conversation stays in Houston.
channels.notConfigured: Slack connections are not ready for this Houston space. Ask your Houston administrator to finish setting up Slack, then refresh.
channels.unsupported: Channels are unavailable on this Houston installation.
